items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Blanche Calloway. She was running it. She had – the m.c., his name was George Craft, he was a gay guy that was the m.c. He was a singer and the m.c. I remember that crew. I don’t know who was before that or after that. That’s where I remember meeting Ruth Brown, because she was – turned out to be Ruth Brown’s manager.
